MAI Code 2 and Flash

Tackle everyday engineering tasks faster and more affordably.

 Try in GitHub Copilot [https://github.com/features/copilot]

Built for everyday developer work.

MAI Code 2 is at the frontier of cost-performance for everyday enterprise coding tasks and excels in taking code to production. And MAI Code 2 Flash is designed for routine, high-volume, affordable work at scale.

 MAI Code 2 | Everyday enterprise coding

Performance

 

 

Featured partners

 “ 
Our engineers run one of the most advanced 5G networks in the country, and we want to give them the best tools available. For standard 5G network analysis, our custom version of Code 2 Flash outperforms GPT-6.1 Sol, while being 50x cheaper. For more complex workflows, we found that Code 2 delivers frontier performance, at a significantly lower price than alternatives.

 Abhay Dabholkar
 AVP – Data Science

 “ 
In pursuit of a zero-accident future, the automated-driving software we develop follows MISRA, an automotive industry coding standard for reliable embedded software. Out of the box, MAI Code 2 Flash is a powerful, efficient agentic coding model. After fine-tuning on our MISRA fix history, it delivered ready-to-merge fixes for 44% of cases where fixes from the frontier models we run in production needed human rework, at less than one-tenth of the cost. That validates the hill-climbing loop we set out to build, and this is only the first step up the hill.

 Suigen Koide 
 Head of DevBoost (Generative AI & MLOps), World Understanding, AD/ADAS, Woven by Toyota
